E.21 Degree-normalized two-hub mean and concentration

Lemma E.524 Degree-normalized wheel seed
✓
#

Lean declarations

  • Oberwolfach.ordinary_normalized_spoke_seed
  • Oberwolfach.ordinary_degree_normalized_spoke_seed
  • Oberwolfach.ordinary_degree_normalized_seed_bounds

Dividing the original fixed cycle weights by half the parent degree parameter gives wheel coefficients at the concentration scale and an explicit parent spoke-load error controlled by the degree deviation and conflict loss.

Proof ▼

Transfer the cycle vertex sum to the wheel seed and use the parent degree lower bound for the coefficient estimate.

✓

Evaluate the omitted-root product and apply the fixed-seed parent-load estimate.
